summary: @honda and @hyundai are top 20 employers in Alabama. I think it is time for a boycott until they divest from the state of Alabama. Is that what you want in a car company? One who will let women rot in prison for wanting to control their reproductive rights?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@honda and @hyundai are top 20 employers in Alabama. I think it is time for a boycott until they divest from the state of Alabama.

Is that what you want in a car company? One who will let women rot in prison for wanting to control their reproductive rights?
